messages:
Jen (partnerships): Quick sync — hardware partner wants a joint marketplace listing + private offer. Need a plan for a volume ceiling (to protect margins) + co-announce timing. Thoughts?
Omar (sales): Do we have a recommended ceiling formula? usually % of historical run rate + a buffer. also need renewal language.
Kai (hw-alliances): From the HW side we can commit to a promo window aligned with their launch (6 weeks). Prefer a hard ceiling on credits so they don’t over-allocate. co-announce ideally after customer onboarding docs are live.
Clara (legal): Heads up — private offers must include renewal opt-in terms and an explicit SKU exhaustion clause. suggested: 90-day notice before renewal opt-out, and a per-SKU cap.
marketplace-bot: FYI: recent marketplace analytics for similar bundles show 65% utilization of issued credits in first 90 days, tapering to 15% over next 9 months. Link: https://console.redwood/marketplace/metrics/insights-2026
Jen (partnerships): Ok — proposal: 3-tier ceiling model (pilot, growth, enterprise) with escalating discounts and hard credit caps per tier. Pilot = 50k credits, Growth = 300k, Enterprise = 2M. Discounts: 15%, 22%, 30% respectively. Renewal: auto-offer with 60-day renewal window unless customer opts out.
Omar (sales): I like tiers. Need option to stack a short-term HW promo (extra 5%) without changing the cap logic — maybe a separate promo SKU that consumes the same credit pool but expires at promo end.
Kai (hw-alliances): Promo SKU works. We’ll provide co-branded collateral and a press date. Request: embargo release until docs + console tile are live.
Clara (legal): Make sure promo SKU has an explicit expiry timestamp and a clause that unredeemed promo credits are void after expiry. Also require joint announcement approval flow: legal review + partner sign-off 7 business days before public release.
Jen (partnerships): Drafting two templates: (A) private-offer-standard.json (tiers + caps) and (B) promo-addon.json (short-lived promo SKU). Posting sample for feedback: 
```json
{
  "offer_type": "private",
  "tiers": [
    {"name":"pilot","cap":"50000","discount":"15%"},
    {"name":"growth","cap":"300000","discount":"22%"},
    {"name":"enterprise","cap":"2000000","discount":"30%"}
  ],
  "renewal_window_days": 60,
  "promo_addon": {"sku":"HW_PROMO_2026","expires":"2026-09-30T23:59:59Z"}
}
```
Omar (sales): Nice. I can mock two customer-facing examples (SaaS midmarket + SI-led enterprise) by EOD.
Kai (hw-alliances): I’ll sync with partner PM to confirm co-announce slot and share the collateral draft by tomorrow.
Clara (legal): I’ll convert the clauses into contract language and insert the SKU expiry + renewal opt-out text. Expect a draft in 48 hours.
Jen (partnerships): Next steps: Omar drafts customer examples, Kai confirms partner timing, Clara finalizes legal text. I’ll assemble the marketplace listing checklist and schedule the announcement gating. tagging @Omar @Kai @Clara — thanks! :tada:
